tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (shrī)༄༅/ /srog bdag dmar po'i drag sngags shan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/prā ṇa āt+ma lu hi ti sha man+t+ra tsa la
(shrī)༄༅/ /srog bdag dmar po'i drag sngags shan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud bzhugs so/ /༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/prā ṇa āt+ma lu hi ti sha man+t+ra tsa la

tei:div.tei:p: (shrī)༄༅// srog bdag dmar po'i drag sngags shan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud bzhugs so// ༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ prā ṇa āt+ma lu hi ti sha man+t+ra tsa la ri tan+t+ra/ bod skad du/ srog bdag dmar po'i drag sngags bshan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud/ dpal gshin rje gshed nag po la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ nyi ma byang shar gyi mtshams/ ri dmar po khrag gi ral pa can/ byi ru'i thang dmar po yod pa/ nam mkha' la byang sprin dmar po yod pa'i gseb na glog 'khyug pa la zangs kyi 'tshubs ma dmar po 'tshubs pa/ mkhar zangs kyi sgo can/ mi mgo'i rus pa'i phreng ba can/ logs la mi khrag dang rta khrag byugs pa/ dred mo lag rdebs dang*/ 'phar ba rkang rdebs dang*/ dur khrod kyi gcan gzan dang*/ bse khra dung khra la sogs pa ltas ngan gyi bya sna tshogs te/ de lta bu'i 'jigs su rung ba'i nang na/ pha gnod sbyin zangs kyi ral pa can/ ma gnod sbyin khrag gi ral pa can gnyis tshogs pa las/ phyis de lo'i dus su byi ru'i sgo nga dmar po gcig dang*/ bse'i sgo nga dmar po gcig byung ngo*// sgo nga dmar po de gnyis nam mkha' la 'phur/ sa la 'dzul/ bar snang la 'phyos/ pha ma gnyis kyis ma thul lo// pha ma gnyis kyis gnod sbyin gyi phug nas ma hā de wa spyan drangs nas sgo nga gnyis po brtol ba'i nang na/ gcig gi nang na byi ru'i mi dmar po skra ltag par bcings pa/ zangs kyi beg tse dang*/ zangs kyi ral kha gyon pa/ zangs kyi mda' gzhu dang zangs kyi gri bsnams pa/ bse mdung dmar po thogs pa/ dar gyi ru mtshon bsgrengs pa/ ra slog dmar po gyon pa/ byu ru'i 'khar ba thogs pa cig byung*/ de la ma hā de was gsol pa/ gnod sbyin khyod su'i sprul pa yin/ ming ci yin/ srog gi snying po gang yin/ zas skal gang yin/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gang yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ gnod sbyin gyis smras pa/

kye lha chen ma hā de wa lags/ bdag ni gshin rje nag po'i sprul pa lags/ ming ni skyes bu dbang gi mdog can zhes kyang bya/ srog bdag dmar po zhes kyang bya/ yam shud dmar po zhes kyang bya/ srog snying ni 'di lags/ oṃ prā ṇa āt+ma k+ṣe ru pu ru ṣa lu hi ta sarba sha trum̐ mā ra ya phaṭa/ bdag gi zas skal ni/ bsgral ba'i zhing bcu lags/ bsnyen sgrub las la sbyar ba ni// dur khrod chu 'gram brag dmar ram// brag dang chu 'thabs la sogs su// der ni bsgrub cing las la sbyar// zhes gsungs so// ma ru tse shan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// ༈ /de nas ma hā de was gsol pa/ skyes bu dbang gi mdog can khyod// gong du bstan pa'i gnas de ru// bstan pa srung ba'i rnal 'byor pas// rdzas kyi rim pa ji ltar bsogs// bzlas pa'i grangs ni du yis 'grub// mtshan rtags kyi ni rim pa gang*// bskul dang gtor ma ji ltar gtang*// ma grub spogs pa ji ltar bya// shi sa sprug ldog ji ltar bya// zhes gsungs pas/ ma ru tses smras pa/ kye kye ma hā de wa lags// rig 'dzin ldan pa'i rnal 'byor pas// dkyil 'khor mda' gang gru bzhir brtsigs// khyi dmar khrag gis chag chag gdab// dbus su gru gang 'brub khung brtsigs// btsan bya dmar pos bsgron pa'i mda'// dar dmar btags la gzugs la gzugs// rtsang dmar nyi shu rtsa gcig ni// shan pa'i tshogs su dbang bskur la// 'brub khung thams cad bskor bar bya// mi'am yang na ra khyi yi// sog pa dug gis byugs byas la// ming rus bris la dbus su gzhug /nyungs kar bra'o skye tshe dang*// dug dang zangs phye lcags phye dang*// grir shi'i thal chen rdzas kyis brab// btsan bshos gser skyems bcas pas mchod// yi ge tri yi spro bsdu yis// gnod sbyin dmar po mdun du bskyed// gong gi srog snying sum 'bum 'don// de la 'di btags sngags kyis bskyed// oṃ prā ṇa lu he ta āt+ma lo hi ta mā ra ya rbad/

rdzas dang las sngags brab par bya// skya shar rta pa mang po dang*// zhub can khye'u chung mang po dang*// na chung mdzes ma'i tshogs rnams ni// 'grub pa'i rtags su shes par bya// ba spu gyen langs snying mi dga'// khro zhing 'ded dang mdze pho rnams// ldog pa'i rtags su shes par bya// srog chags bsad dang shing bu bcad// las la sbyar ba'i rtags su bshad// ma ru tse shan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud las/ rdzas dang bca' gzhi sngags kyi grangs dang rtags kyi le'u ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ /de nas bskul zhing gtor ma btang ba'i 'di gsungs so// kye gnod sbyin zangs kyi beg tse can// sgrub pa po yi las gyis la// ma hā de wa'i bka' la nyon// gshin rje gshed po'i las gyis shig /gdong dmar ma yis sna drongs la// nyams pa'i srog rtsa myur du chod// ra dmar khrag dang snying sna'i tshogs// btsan bshos gser skyems bdud rtsis mchod// oṃ prā ṇa āt+ma lu he ta ba lin+ta gṛh+ṇa sha trūṃ mā ra ya khā hi/ byang shar mtshams su gtong*/ tsit+ta ming rus rgyun du bcang*/ ma ru tse shan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud las/ bskul zhing gtor ma btang ba'i le'u ste gsum pa'o// ༈ /des ma grub na spogs pa dang shi sa bstan pa 'di gsungs so// tsa ra dmar po'i blud bu ru// gzungs dang srog snying bcas la gzhug /smyug ma tshigs dgu gdab cing brab// lha sngags mjug la bh+yoḥbatags la// rtsa ba'i snying po 'bru bzlog pa// gshin rje nag po'i dgongs pas bcad// ltas ngan 'dod na spu rnams bsogs// ma ru tse shan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud las/ spogs pa dang*/ 'bru bzlog shis bstan pa'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// ༈ /de nas mahā de was/ ma ru tse legs so// khyod kyis phyi rabs kyi don du bshad pa'i rgyud 'di gsungs pa ngo mtshar che'o// zhes rjes su yi rangs pa phul nas mi snang bar gyur to// ma ru tse shan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud las/

rjes su yi rangs pa'i le'u ste lnga pa'o// ༈ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po shrī dha ra kra shu dang*/ mar pa lo tsā bas dbus grwa thang gi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dmar po khrag gi mda' 'phen ma'i rgyud bzhugs so// rgya gar skad du/ tsa tu ka ma la pra ma du te kyi tan+t+ra/ bod skad du/ dmar po khrag gi mda' 'phen ma'i ngan sngags shan pa dmar po'i rgyud/ srid pa thams cad kyi yum e ka dzā ṭi ma la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ nyi ma byang shar gyi mtshams mya ngam gyi rnam par 'das pa na zangs thang dmar po/ zangs ri smug po/ zangs sprin dmar po'i mda' na khrag gi mtsho/ phu na zangs kyi brag khrag mtsho dmar nag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i nang bse mkhar smug po/ zangs sgo dmar po/ sgo bzhi'i nang na zangs kyi chu srin ngur ba/ khrag gi zham chu dmar po 'bab pa/ de'i nang na mi ro rta ro gcal du bkram pa/ mi khrag rta khrag mtsho ru 'khyil pa/ thod pa'i gzhal yas khang gi nang na pha gnod sbyin zangs kyi ral pa can dang*/ ma srin mo khrag gi ral pa can gnyis 'tshogs pa las pha zhe sdang che/ ma 'dod chags che/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gnyis kyi bu byi ru'i sgo nga dang bse'i sgo nga gnyis byung*/ pha mas ma thul nas bar snang du 'phyos/ bar snang gi gza' brgyad btul/ steng du 'phos lha chen brgyad btul/ 'og tu 'phos klu chen brgyad btul/ pha ma yang za la khad pa las/ yum chen e ka dzā ṭi mas thugs rje chen po bskyed nas dbang sdud chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga brgyabs pas byi ru'i sgo nga las skyes bu dbang gi mdog can byung*/ bse'i sgo nga'i nang nas srid pa'i bu mo gdong dmar ma mdog sngo ba/ gdong pa bse/ so dung*/ smin ma g.yu/ me'i ral pa can/ dbu skra mchong dang mu men gyis brgyan pa/ zangs kyi gri rnon po dang phur pa thogs pa/ dred mo mi zan la zhon pa cig byung*/

de nas de'i tshe yum chen e ka dzā ṭis gsol pa/ srid pa'i bu mo gdong dmar ma// khyod kyis bstan pa bsrung dgos pas// srog gi snying po gang yin dang*// ming dang gsang mtshan gang yin dang*// zas skal gang yin smros shig srid pa'i bu mos smras pa/ bdag gi srog gi snying po ni// oṃ rak+mo ya ma tsit+ta dz+wa la raṃ pra ti de wī hūm̐ srog la ya ma dzaḥ a mu kaṃ sha trūṃ mā ra ya/ ming ni rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma// gsang mtshan ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ bdag gi zas skal ni/ bstan pa la gnod par byed pa rnams kyi srog dbugs lags/ zhes gsungs so// dmar po shan pa'i rgyud las gleng gzhi'i le'u ste dang po'o// ༈ /de nas e ka dzā ṭi mas/ rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma la 'di skad ces gsungs so// pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung slad du// gnas ni gang dang gang du bsgrub// rdzas dang rten ni ci la bya// sngags kyi grangs dang rtags ni ci// bskul zhing zor ni ci ltar 'phangs// pho mo sbags na ci ltar sbags// pho btsun mo btsun gang ltar yin// zhes gsungs so// dmar po shan pa'i rgyud las rgyud dngos po yongs su dril ba'i le'u ste gnyis pa'o// ༈ /de nas yum gyis smras pa'i lan// rig pa'i lha mos rjes smras pa// phyi rabs rnal 'byor sgrub pa la// gnas kyi rim pa bstan pa yang*// ri gsum

klu dang ma mo gnas pa'am gnas sa/ 'dus dang chu gsum 'dus// dur khrod dbus su bdag nyid bsgrub// dkyil 'khor mthing nag gru gsum bca'// smug nag kha lug nag po/ skya'i tsit+ta la// dar sna mang po btags la gzugs// seng ldeng phur pa sor brgyad pa// gsang sngags bris pa mdun du gzugs// bdag nyid lha mi nga rgyal gyis// mdun du rak+ta'i maṇ+ḍal la// yi ge ma yi 'phro 'dus las// srid pa'i bu mo bskyed cing bsgom// sngags kyi 'od kyis bdag nyid bskul// sum 'bum grangs kyis 'grub par 'gyur// chu dang me dang bu mo dang*// rta pa dmar po byung gyur na// 'grub pa'i rtags su shes par bya// mdze pho pho mo ldog pa'i rtags// srog chags bsad na las la sbyar// ces gsungs so// dmar po shan pa'i rgyud las gnas dang*/ rten dang*/ rdzas dang*/ sngags dang*/ rtags kyi le'u ste gsum pa'o// ༈ /de nas bskul zhing zor 'phang ba 'di skad do// bh+yoḥ rig pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma// gshin rje gshed po'i bka' nyan ma// e ka dzā ṭi'i gsung sdod ma// lha mo 'bum gyi g.yul ngo bzlog /bse yi skyes bu'i sna 'dren ma// ma mo 'bum gyi dbang mo che// rgyan cha ma mo mthu mo che// gsang ba'i ma mo yal gam can// cho 'phrul yongs kyi sna 'dren ma// sdang ba'i dgra la cho 'phrul thong*// nga yi nor gyi steng la rgyug /srog bdag dmar po'i rting la rgyug /nga dang 'gras pa'i dgra bo la// cho 'phrul dpung rnams tshogs su bsogs// spre'u 'ug pa wa khra dang*// spyang ki dang ni bya nag dang*// srin bya dang ni gla ba sogs// smyo 'bogs 'khrugs dang 'thab dang gri// cho 'phrul sna tshogs myong bar rigs// blud bu brdabs na cho 'phrul 'ong*// smyug ma brdabs na rims nad 'ong*// spu rnams bsogs na ltas ngan 'ong*// thun la bsngags la zor du 'phang*// yang na rkyang ma yang na sngags// zhes gsungs so// dmar po shan pa'i rgyud las bskul zhing cho 'phrul dang*/

zor 'phang ba'i le'u ste bzhi pa'o// ༈ /de yang pho mo sbags shing gcun thabs 'di gsungs so// ra khyi mi yi sog pa yi// ling ga 'brub khung nang du gzhug /mda' dmar dar dmar rten du gzugs// ming po bskul zhing sngags 'dis 'bod// oṃ prā ṇa āt+ma k+ṣe ru pu ru ṣa lu he ta a mu ka sha trūṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ sring mo g.yel na ming po gcun// zhes gsungs so// dmar po shan pa'i rgyud las pho mo sbags pa dang*/ gcun thabs le'u ste lnga pa'o// ༈ /de nas dmar po sgrol byed shan pa'i rgyud gsungs pa ni ngo mtshar che'o// zhes gsungs so// yum e ka dzā ṭis rjes su yi rang ba phul nas chos kyi dbyings su gshegs so// dmar po shan pa'i rgyud las rjes su yi rang ba'i le'u ste drug pa'o// ༈ /dmar po 'jig rten za byed ma'i rgyud rdzogs so// 'di shin tu gnyan pas dar dmar pos dril/ mis mi mthong bar sba'o// rgya gar gyi mkhan po dha ra kra shu dang*/ bod kyi lo tsā ba mar pas yul dbus kyi grwa thang gi gtsug lag khang du bsgyur ba'o// / sa ma ya rgya rgya// ༈ /gnod sbyin lcam dral gyi bsnyen sgrub las gsum lag tu blang ba'i rim pa ha la nag po dug gi spu gri zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma mchog dang rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gnod sbyin beg gdong lcam dral sgrub pa la gnyis te/ thog mar byung tshul lo rgyus ni/ sngon bskal pa 'das pa'i dus na yab rgyal po gser gyi shugs can dang*/ yum btsun mo ut+pa la'i spyan gnyis kyi sras su sku mched gnyis yod pa las/ gcen grags ldan ni bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa nyid yin la/ gcung grags skyes ni gnod sbyin 'di yin no// khong gnyis phyi nang gi grub mtha' la ma 'chams pas/ cho long gang rgyal gyi rjes su 'jug par byas nas cho long btang nas gcen rgyal te/ da nga'i chos lugs la zhugs shig gsungs pas gcung ma nyan te bros pa las/

gcen gyis bdas te bzung ba las gcung na re/ bdag bsad kyang nyid kyi chos la mi 'jug pas/ de bas bdag ma bsad par thong*/ gcen nyid ni sangs rgyas pa'i dus bdag gis srung ma bya ste/ bstan pa la gnod pa rnams kyi srog dbugs dbral bar bgyi'o// bstan pa bshig pa la chad pa bcad par bgyi'o// zhes khas blangs dam bcas so// der gcen gyis gcung la dbang bskur te/ nga nam sangs rgyas pa'i dus su khyod bstan srung du gyur cig nga'i bstan pa la gnod pa'i srog gi gshed mar gyis shig khyod kyis nga yi bstan pa 'phel bar gyis shig ces gsungs nas dbang rtags su zangs kyi ya lad dang*/ byi ru'i dbyug pa dang*/ bse'i mda' gzhu lag tu gtad nas/ ming yang srog bdag yam shud dmar por btags so// de nas bcom ldan 'das nyid zhing 'dir sangs rgyas pa'i tshul bstan pa na/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi dbang gis nyi ma byang shar gyi mtshams/ chu med pa'i mya ngam gyi thang chen po 'das pa'i pha rol ma ru tse'i dur khrod ces bya ba/ byi ru'i thang dmar po yangs pa'i ljongs/ mchong gi byang ri dmar po khrag gi ral pa can gyi mdun/ khrag mtsho dmar nag rba klong khol ba'i klong*/ nam mkha' la byang sprin dmar po 'khrigs pa'i gseb na glog 'khyug cing 'brug ldir ba/ sa gzhi thams cad khrag gi na bun dang*/ zangs 'tshubs chen po gtibs pa na/ bse mkhar smug po bse'i kha bad can/ zangs kyi sgo can/ sgo nang zangs kyi chu srin ngur ba/ rta khrag dang mi khrag mtsho ru 'khyil ba/ thod pa'i gur khang chen po'i nang pha gnod sbyin zangs kyi ral pa can/ ma gnod sbyin khrag gi ral pa can gnyis 'tshogs pa las/ phyis de lo'i dus su byi ru'i sgo nga gcig dang bse'i sgo nga dmar po gcig dang gnyis byung ngo*// sgo nga de gnyis pha mas ma thub par nam mkha' la 'phur lha chen brgyad btul/ bar snang du 'phyos gza' chen brgyad btul/ sa gzhi la 'dzul klu chen brgyad btul/

pha ma yang za la thug pa na/ pha ma gnyis kyis bskul bas/ dur khrod gnod sbyin gyi phug na ma hā de wa dang yum chen e ka dzā ṭis thugs rje chen po bskyed nas/ dbang sdud chen po'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas kha ṭ+wāṃ ga brgyabs pas sgo nga gnyis brdol ba las byi ru'i sgo nga nas/ byi ru'i mi dmar po skra ltag par bcing ba/ zangs kyi beg tse dang sa la gyon pa/ bse yi mda' gzhu dang zangs kyi ral gri bsnams pa/ bse'i mdung dmar dang dar gyi ru mtshon bsgreng ba/ ra slog dmar po dang byi ru'i 'khar ba thogs pa gcig byung*/ de la ma hā de was gnod sbyin khyod su'i sprul pa yin/ ming ci yin/ khyod kyi srog snying gang yin/ zas skal ni gang yin/ bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gang yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ des smras pa/ kye/ ma hā de wa lags/ bdag ni gshin rje nag po'i gsung gi sprul pa lags/ bdag gi ming ni skyes bu dbang gi mdog can zhes kyang bya/ srog bdag dmar po zhes kyang bya/ yam shud dmar po zhes kyang bya/ bdag gi srog snying ni 'di lags so// zhes dri ba dris lan gyi tshul du ma ru tse shan pa sgrol byed kyi rgyud gsung*/ bse'i sgo nga'i nang nas srid pa'i bu mo mdog mthing shun ltar sngo ba/ bse dmar po'i gdong pa can/ so dung*/ smin ma g.yu/ me'i ral pa can/ mchong dang mu men gyis brgyan pa/ zangs kyi gri rnon dang phur pa thogs pa/ dred mo mi zan la zhon pa gcig byung*/ de la yum e ka dzā ṭi mas gsol pa/ srid pa'i bu mo gdong dmar ma khyod kyis bstan pa bsrung dgos pas srog snying gang yin/ ming dang gsang mtshan gang yin/ zas skal gang yin smros shig ces gsungs pas/ srid pa'i bu mos smras pa/ bdag gi srog gi snying po ni 'di'o zhes so// ming ni srid pa'i lha mo gdong dmar ma/ gsang mtshan pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug ma/ bdag gi zas skal ni bstan pa la gnod par byed pa'i srog dbug lags/

zhes zhus shing*/ de nas dri ba dris lan gyi tshul du dmar po shan pa 'jig rten za byed ma'i rgyud gsungs so// de ltar rgyud kyi rgyud khungs brten nas/ rgya gar gyi yul du sngags kyi nus pa mthar phyin pa a tsa ra nyi ma grags zhes bya bas ma hā de wa la lung nod de/ rgya gar bam so dmar po zhes bya ba nas gter phyung nas bsgrubs pas 'grub/ dgra la mig gis bltas pa tsam gyis dgra 'chi ba byung*/ des sras paṇ+ḍi ta zla ba nag po la gnang*/ de khros pa'i mod la dgra 'chi ba byung*/ des sras ga ya dha ra la gnang*/ 'di la bod du mtshan la a tsa ra dmar po zhes kyang zer/ shrī dha ra kra shu zhes kyang bya/ 'on kyang bla chen 'brog mi'i bla ma ga ya dha ra dang mi gcig go /des zhag gsum bsgrubs pas dgra 'chi ba byung*/ 'dis bod du byon nas mar pa lo tsā ba la dbus kyi grwa thang gi gtsug lag khang du chos skyong 'di'i skor gnang*/ gong gi rgyud gnyis rgya gzhung 'ga' dang bcas pa lo paṇa gnyis kyis bsgyur/ paṇ+ḍi ta 'dis mnga' ris gung thang du bon po gcig la gnang*/ gtsang du cog ro'i zog ban dar ma skyabs la gnang*/ gtso cher gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags la chos skor yongs su rdzogs par gnang ste/ gnyan los dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa'i bka' sdod shan pa dmar nag gi tha snyad byed cing rtsub grags che/ sgrub yig mdos chog bskul byang sogs bka' rgya che bar mdzad/ des gnam kha'u pa la gnang*/ des rje sa chen la gnang*/ des kho rang gi nye gnas ra pa shud bu bkra shis 'od zer la gnang*/ des grub thob 'dar phya ru pa la gnang*/ yang ban+de dar ma skyabs kyis mar pa lo tsā ba la yang zhus/ de la yang shud bu bkra shis 'od zer gyis zhus so// yang nye brgyud ni/ nag rgyal lha chu'i dben gnas su slob dpon pad+ma dngos su byon nas grub thob 'dar 'phyar la/ yang gsang khros pa lha dgu'i man ngag bka' srung 'di dang bcas pa gnang bar grags shing*/

yang chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyis/ slob dpon pad+ma bod du spyan drangs dus bsam yas kyi gtsug lag khang du sbas pa/ gnubs sangs rgyas ye shes kyis gter nas bton pa'i srog bdag yam shud dmar po'i sgrub yig rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ drag po las kyi shog dril bcu dang bcas pa sngags 'chang drag sngags kyi bdag po bsnubs pa dag las brgyud pa dang*/ gzhan yang mang yul byams sprin gyi lha khang dang*/ spa gro skyer chu dang*/ ru lag rgyang gi brag ri rnams nas bton pa'i srung ma 'di'i sgrub thabs kyi rigs shin tu mang ba dag snang zhing*/ sgrub tshul la'ang*/ gnod sbyin pho rkyang du sgrub pa dang*/ gdong dmar mo rkyang du sgrub pa dang*/ gtso 'khor gnyis su sgrub pa dang*/ lcam dral gsum du sgrub pa dang*/ shan pa dgu skor gyi sgrub pa/ ro shan nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bskor ba/ thams cad sbags te sgrub pa/ de la'ang myur zhing rno ba'i phyir/ dgra pho sgrol ba'i phyir pho rgyud gtso bor sgrub pa/ dgra mo sgrol ba'i phyir mo rgyud gtso mor sgrub pa/ pho rgyud la'ang btsan rgod ltar sgrub pa rta la zhon pa/ srog bdag ltar sgrub pa ra skyes la zhon pa/ bka' sdod ltar sgrub pa rkang thang can la sogs pa mang du yod cing de rnams la lha dang*/ sngags dang*/ sgrub rdzas dang*/ sgrub tshul gyi khyad par mi 'dra ba du ma zhig yod pa rnams thun mong ba rnams mi 'gal zhing*/ thun mong ma yin pa ma 'dres pa'i sgo nas so sor ston shes pa'i bla ma man ngag ldan pa zhig mi bsten kha med du snang bas/ 'di sgrub par 'dod pa'i dpyod ldan dag gis shes par byos shig ding sang srung ma 'di la myur zhing rtsub che bas bstan par rlom pa mang yang*/ phal cher gtor bsngos rkyang par byed pa ma gtogs/ man ngag gi gnad cung zad tsam yang rna bas ma thos pa 'ba' zhig tu snang ngo*// 'dir ni rgyud gnyis dang shrī dha ra kra shu'i dgongs pa/

bla ma gnyan lo tsā ba'i bzhed srol/ mkhas grub kyi bla ma dam pa gsum gyi man ngag gis brgyan te/ las myur zhing rtsub pa'i rkang thang can 'khor bcas kyi sgrub tshul lag tu blang ba'i thabs bshad par bya'o// gnyis pa sgrub thabs dngos la gnyis las/ dang po rten bca' ba ni/ phyi'i rten du rta dmar po/ g.yag kham pa/ ra skyes dmar po/ khyi dmar po/ lug dmar po lcags kha rnams phum phum dang sog shul la lcam dral gyi srog snying rgya shog la gser ram gri khrag gis bris pa'i mthar/ rten 'di la bzhugs nas sgrub pa po bdag gi srung ma mdzod/ mi nor dang dgon nas dang gnas gzhi'i gnyer mdzod/ khyer ba po la cho 'phrul sna tshogs ston la myur du khug cig ces pa'i spel tshig dang bcas pa dar dmar po'i skud pas dkris pa/ 'bru sna/ sman sna/ rin po che/ dar zab dang bcas pa'i thum bu dar dmar pos dril ba mi mngon par btags te cho ga bzhin btsugs pa dang*/ nang gi rten du smyug rgod tshigs gsum pa'i sbubs sman dang rin po ches bkang ba/ dur bya'am 'ug pa'i spus brgyan pa/ gri lcags kyi mde'u gri rgyus kyis bsdams pa/ gri khrag gis ltong la yi ge pram̐/ rked pa la dzaḥ mde'u la rbad bris pa'i mgul du dar zab dmar po kha longs pa la yab kyi srog snying gser gyis bris pa dang*/ dar nag la yum gyi srog snying gser gyis bris pa gdags/ yum gyi rten du seng ldeng gi phur pa sor brgyad pa dar snas dkris pa dang*/ las mkhan rten du zangs dmar gyi phur pa sor brgyad pa gri rgyus kyis mgul du btags pa bsham/ gsang ba'i rten du smyug rgod tshigs dgu pa'i mgo mjug tu seng ldeng gi rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pas bkag pa'i nang du yi dam gyi srog gi mjug tu gnod sbyin lcam dral gyi srog sngags 'bru ldog ste bris pa'i shog dril gyis bkag pa dang*/ ra skyes dmar po'i blud bu'i nang du gri khrag dang rgya snag gis lcam dral gyi srog snying spel tshig dang bcas pa tshar mang po bris pa gzugs/

sku'i rten la dur khrod kyi ras la gri khrag gis bris pa'i lcam dral gyi sku tsaka li/ gsung gi rten du 'di'i rgyud sgrub thabs kyi pusti/ thugs kyi rten du gsang ba'i bla rdo dang*/ shan pa'i lag nas blangs pa'i ra dmar po'i tsit+ta dang*/ lug nag po'i tsit+ta'i nang du yab dang yum gyi snying po spel tshig dang bcas pa gser ram gri khrag gis bris pa'i shog dril sman dang*/ dri dang*/ rin po che dang*/ dar zab kyis bkang ba rnams bsham/ gnyis pa sgrub pa dngos la/ rnal 'byor pa dam tshig dang sdom par ldan zhing yi dam gyi lha khro bo gang yang rung ba'am/ khyad par shis pa gshin rje gshed dam/ yang gsang khros pa'i bsnyen pa mthar phyin pas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir gnod sbyin lcam dral sgrub par 'dod pas/ pho'i gnas brag dmar po gshin rje'am/ sog po khros pa 'dra ba'i 'gram mam/ brag dang chu 'thab pa/ 'ug pa dang srin bya'i skad grags pa/ btsan yod nges pa'i gnas su sgrub/ yum gyi gnas ri gsum 'dus pa'i gnas/ chu gsum 'dus pa'i 'gram/ ma mo 'dus pa'i dur khrod du bsgrub/ de dag ni shin tu 'grub pa'i gnas yin la/ de dag ye ma grub na brag phug la sogs pa dben zhing yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su gnam sa'i rgyan dgram pa sogs dang*/ yi dam dang gnod sbyin 'khor bcas kyi bris sku sogs legs par bshams pa'i mdun ngogs su/ phyi rabs chod pa'i ri hrul gyi sa dang*/ dur khung gi sa dmar po rnams bong bu gwa dmar dang ra thug gi chus khu ba byas pa'i stegs bu mda' gang gru bzhi pa brtsig de'i dbus su 'brub khung gru gsum khru gang ba/ gting du mdzub gang gi dpangs yod pa kha khyer dang ldan pa brus la/ de rnams la btsan dug dang ro sol/ khyi dmar gyi khrag ra dmar gyi khrag gri khrag rnams sbyar bas byugs/ 'brub khung gi mthil du dur thal gri rus kyi phye ma dgram/ de nas dug gis bsad pa'i khrag gis dgra'i ling ga sor bzhi pa shog bu la bris pa'i dpral bar rus/

snying gar ming*/ brla la bla dgas/ yan lag bzhi la dzaḥbazhi/ dpung mgo gnyis/ pus mo gnyis/ spyi bo rnams su rbad/ mtha' ma la gnyen bshes yi ming gis bskor/ de rnams kyi mthar/ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa bris/ de la 'gugs gzhug yid ches pa byas la bstabs nas gri skud kyis bcings/ khyi dang mi'i rus pa/ spyang ki'i brun/ mgar ba'i tshwa rdog dgra'i yul lam gnas gzhi'i sgo'i shing*/ mgar ba'i 'og rdo dang*/ tho ba'i lcags kyi dum bu/ mi sdig can gyi skra dang brun/ dmigs pa'i dgra gang yin gyi dri ma bshang gci sogs gang rnyed/ de rnams zhib par brdungs pa'i khu ba gri khrag gis sbrus pa'i ling ga sor brgyad pa'i snying gar bcug la/ de bcings pa'i gri rgyus drangs te ling ga'i ske la se ching du bcings/ ling ga de 'brub khung gi mthil du bzhag ra dmar po'am/ khyi dmar po'i sog pa'i nang ngos gri khrag dang*/ sbrang rgod la btsan dug dang*/ thang phrom dang*/ rgya snag sbyar ba byugs pa gcig gi ngos la/ 'ug pa'i sgro rtsa'i myu gus ra dmar khyi dmar gyi khrag dang*/ zangs phyi sbyar bas pho'i 'khor lo dpe'u chung ltar bris/ phyi ngos smyug gtsang gis btsan dug dang*/ lug nag gi khrag dang*/ gri lcags kyi phye ma sbyar bas mo'i 'khor lo dpe'u chung ltar bri/ de gnyis kha sbyor ba'i bar du ro ras la gri khrag gis dgra bo'i ling ga man ngag ltar bris pa bcug nas/ sngar gyi ling ga'i rke la btags pa'i gri rgyus kyis rgya gram du bsdam/ brub khung gi kha g.yam dmar pos 'grigs par bcad/ de'i steng du mañji dma' ba gcig gi steng du gri thod tshad ldan gyi nang du thugs kyi rten snying gnyis/ gsang ba'i bla rdo rdzas can man ngag ltar bcas la/ rin po che/ sman sna/ 'bru sna/ dri bzang po/ dar zab mang po rnams kyis phyur bur bkang ba dar dmar pos dril te bzhag de'i steng du ches mtho ba'i mañji sogs kyi khar 'bru sna tshogs khrag gis sbrus pa'i gtor ma dmar po gsum bshams/

de la nang rten gyi mda' dar mgul du sku'i rten tsaka li btags pa dang*/ gsang rten smyug rgod tshigs dgu pa bcug la bzhag 'brub khung gi kha khyer la dug shing gi rtsang rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs can dug khrag gis byugs pa nyer gcig srin mo 'gros su btsug 'brub khung gi g.yas ngos kyi stegs bu'i khar zangs phur gri khrag gis ngar blud pa phur khung du gzugs pa la ling ga'i gri rgyus thun khung las drangs te brtod la bzhag g.yon ngos la seng ldeng gi phur bu yum gyi sngags bris pa phur gdan la btsug mdun du 'khor bcas kyi rtag gtor dang*/ 'phral du phul ba'i gtor ma khrag chang gi mchod yon sogs nyer spyod lnga dang bcas pa bsham/ de thams cad kyi thog la ra dmar gyi blud bu sngags can gyi nang du spre'u dang*/ wa dang*/ stag dang*/ spyang ki la sogs pa gcan gzan gyi rigs mang po'i spu dang mche sder gang rnyed/ 'ug pa dang*/ khra dang*/ srin bya dang*/ bya rog la sogs pa 'dab chags kyi sgro dang mche sder rnyed tshad/ gla ba dang sha ba la sogs pa'i ri dwags mang po'i spu dang bcas pa bcug la btags/ de'i g.yas g.yon du srin bya 'ug pa gang rnyed kyi gsob kyang bsham/ de nas sgrub pa pos yi dam lha gang yin pa'i bdag bskyed bzlas pa dang bcas pa tshang bar byas nas/ mdun gyi mchod rdzas rnams a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las gnod sbyin 'khor bcas su bskyed la/ de la ye shes pa spyan drangs shing bstim pa dam bzhag mchod bstod gtor ma 'bul ba rnams las byang ltar bya/ de nas yi dam gyi sngags brgya rtsa tsam gyis gnya' mnan te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer dmar po che zhing 'od 'bar ba 'phros pas mdun gyi lcam dral gyi sa bon la phog pas dmar zhing chags pa'i rang bzhin du gyur/ 'od zer tshur 'dus pa dang lhan cig lcam dral gyi nus mthu thams cad bdag la thim zhing bka' nyan gsung sdod par bsams la/

oṃ prā ṇa āt+ma k+ṣe ru pu ru ṣa lu hi ta sarba sha trūṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces yab kyi srog sngags dang*/ oṃ rak+mo ya ma tsit+ta dz+wa la raṃ pra ti de wī hūm̐ srog la ya ma dzaḥ sarba sha trūṃ mā ra ya rbad phaṭa/ ces yum gyi snying po dang sbrel te thun bzhir bcad nas mi tshig gis bar ma chod par bzla'o// de yang rgyud las/ sum 'bum grangs kyis 'grub par 'gyur// zhes gsungs zhing bla ma dam pa rnams kyis bzhi 'gyur byas pa'i 'bum phrag bcu gnyis grangs kyi bsnyen par bzhed pa'o// 'dir mtshan ma gtso che bas mdun gyi snying la sogs pa'i rten rdzas 'gul zhing 'phar ba dang*/ tshegs sgra la sogs pa'i sgra 'byin pa dang*/ me 'bar ba la sogs pa dang*/ gzhan yang dngos nyams rmi lam sogs par lcam dral 'khor bcas zhal mthong ba dang*/ mi dmar po sha'i ral pa can dang*/ bud med nag mo khrag gi ral pa can dang*/ mi chen dang*/ sngags pa chas bzang rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ chu chen po'i rba klong 'khrugs pa/ lung pa mes khengs pa/ go gyon zhing chas su gzhug pa'i rta pa mang po rgyug pa/ dmag dpung chen po/ bud med gzhon nu mang po dga' zhing rtse ba/ khyi dmar po chen po/ spyang ki dang mi dred la sogs pa/ rta dmar zhur dang*/ sngon po shin tu che ba/ srin bya 'ug pa la sogs pa'i rnam 'phrul sna tshogs lan gcig ma yin pa yang yang 'byung ba ni nye ba'i rtags yin la/ dngos su snying mi dga' ba/ 'jigs shing ba spu ldang ba/ nyams dang rmi lam du mdze pho mang po 'byung ba ni bzlog pa'i rtags yin pas/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal bskyed cing lta ba la blo 'jog skong bshags mchod bstod la brtson par bya'o// de la bsnyen pa sngon du song ba'i rnal 'byor pas sgrub cing las la sbyar ba'i tshul ni/ bdag mdun bskyed chog sogs sngar ltar byas pa'i rjes su/ mdun gyi 'brub khung ling ga dang bcas pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las kham̐ las gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom gru gsum pa me rlung 'tshubs pa'i dbus su nṛ las dgra bo gang yin pa mngon sum bzhin du 'dar yed par bsams la/

rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa me'i rang bzhin can 'phros pas lcam dral gyi thugs ka'i sa bon la phog pas rang dbang med par khro zhing 'khrugs pa'i nyams can du gyur/ de rnams las rang 'dra'i sprul pa yang sprul phyogs bcur 'phros pas dgra bgegs gang na yod pa'i gnas nas bkug ste/ mdun gyi ling ga la thim zhing skyob pa'i lha thams cad rgyang ring du bskrad par bsams la/ sngags 'dres pa khri phrag gsum la sogs pa bzlas pas/ dgra bo dngos su khrid nas 'brub khung du bcug pa dang*/ shan pa gri thogs pa mang po las ci bgyi zer ba sogs nyams sam rmi lam du 'byung ngo*// las sbyor dngos la 'khor los bsad pa ni/ 'khor lo bsang sbyang stong pa'i ngang las pho 'khor me'i rang bzhin tsha zhing rtsub pa/ mo 'khor chu'i rang bzhin grang zhing bsil pa gnyis ka'ang bsad sngags kyi nga ro 'brug ltar ldir ba'i bar du ling ga dgra bo dngos su gsal ba tshal pa tshal par btang bar bsams la sngags drag tu bzla/ thun gyis bsad pa ni/ 'brub khung nang gi ling ga dgra bor gsal ba la/ gnod sbyin 'khor bcas kyis mtshon cha'i char phab nas thal ba rdul phran du gtong bar bsam zhing*/ yungs dkar nag bra bo/ skye tshe/ zangs lcags phye ma/ grir shi ba'i ro bsregs pa'i thal chen rnams bsres pa'i thun gyis brab cing bsad sngags bzla'o// de ltar thun bzhir bcad cing*/ thun mtshams su lcam dral la dmar gtor ra'i khrag gis brgyan pa dbul zhing bskul drag tu bya/ dmod mo gdab cing dgra phyogs su 'phang*/ de tshe srog chags mang po bsad pa'i sha khrag dmar nyog nyog pa dang*/ spyang kis ra lug bsad pa dang*/ khras byi'u bsad pa dang*/ shan pa la sogs pa'i mi mang po 'tshogs nas sha dmar po za ba dang*/ mgo dang snying dang nang khrol la sogs pa lag tu gtad pa'i rnam pa nyams dang rmi lam sogs su nges par byung na las grub pa yin pas/ rten gyi mda' shan pa'i gzhu la bkang ste/

brub khung nang gi ling ga'i snying bar brgyabs pas rnam shes mar me lta bu de nag thum song nas chos nyid du thim par bsam mo// steng gi gtor ma gnod sbyin 'khor bcas su gsal ba dgra bgegs la 'phros pa 'od du zhu nas mtshon cha dang nad dug gi rang bzhin du gyur pas/ dgra bo'i lus phra rab tu btang bar bsams la 'brub khung nang du kha tshogs su gdab bo// de nas 'brub khung gi gtor ma ling ro sngags kyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa bton nas re bas bstum/ ra dmar po'i pags pa la dril nas mchod rten 'dre can nam brag dmar po bdud btsan drag po gnas pa'i 'gram du sba zhing gnod sbyin 'khor dang bcas pa dang*/ gnas de'i gzhi bdag la gtad gnyer bden bdar drag po bya/ dus gza' mig dmar dang*/ skar ma bya mchu dang khra la byed par bshad do// dngos gzhi'i 'khor lo sgom bzlas gtso bor byas na dgra smyo ba dang lceb pa la sogs pa 'byung*/ thun gtso bor byas na gri ru 'chi'o// gang ltar yang 'di ltar byas pas yun ring mi 'gor bar zhag dang za ma la brlag par bshad pas dam du sba zhing ltas ngan cho 'phrul gtong bar 'dod na sngar gyi ra'i blud bu'i nang gi spu rnams dgra phyogs su gtor zhing blud bu drag tu brdabs/ thun gyi mthar gtong ba'i gtor ma la'ang ltas ngan gyi spu sna tshogs pa btsug ste zor du 'phang ngo*// de ltar yun ring du bsgrubs kyang rtags med pa dang*/ nang rtags byung yang phyi ru las mi 'grub pa la sogs pa dang*/ 'khu zhing bzlog na shi sa bstan pa ni/ sngar gyi ra dmar gyi blud bur tsaka li gnyis 'khor lo ling ga dang bcas pa bcug la/ der ma ru tse'i grong khyer gyi nang gnod sbyin 'khor lo/ de'i mdun du dgra bgegs dang bcas pa gsal btab/ rang gshin rje gshed kyi nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas smyug ma tshigs dgu pa rdo rje'i dbyug par bsams la/ srog sngags mgo mjug bzlog la drag tu bzla zhing brabs pas ma ru tse'i grong khyer thams cad sa g.yos mtsho 'khrugs/

ri 'gul zhing gnod sbyin 'khor los kyang 'jigs shing skrag pas/ dgra bgegs thams cad de ma thag bsad bcad kyi las byas te sha rus thams cad rjes med du gsol bar bsam/ de lta bu zhag gcig gam gnyis sam gsum gyi bar du thun bzhir byas pas mi 'grub mi srid cing*/ 'grub pa dang phyi rten rnams bton la me long khrus gsol zhing gtang rag gi mchod bstod bzang du btang bas mnyes par bya/ de yang ye sdug na min pa byung tshad la byar mi rung gsungs so// deng sang srung ma 'di'i rjes gnang tsam thob pa dang*/ gtor ma 'bul mkhan cung zad snang mod/ 'di lta bu'i bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi rnam dbyer shes pa nyin mo'i skar ma bas kyang ches dkon zhing 'di skor gyi gdams pa cha tshang zong du gser gyi khur po khur nas rgyal khams kun tu btsal kyang rnyed pa'i gnas med la/ spyir chos skyong 'di nyid la gtor bsngo chag med tsam gyis kyang las phra mo phal cher bde blag tu 'grub par snang zhing 'di 'dra'i gdams ngag gi sgo nas bsgrubs na the tshom med par las thams cad byed nges 'dug pas/ su rung rung la ston par mi bya ba ni dam tshig go /sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ 'di nyid mtshungs med dam pa blo gsal rgya mtshos mdzad par grags// //sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
